SELECT tsf.PORTFOLIO_ID, tsf.SEC_ACCT_ID, tsfd.FINPROD_ID,
pspf.INV_AIM,
SUM(NVL(PSPF.AMOUNT, 0)) AMOUNT FROM TRD_STASEC_FLOW tsf LEFT JOIN TRD_STASEC_FLOW_DETAIL tsfd ON tsfd.SEQNO = tsf.SEQNO AND tsfd.BRANCH = #{BRANCH_0, jdbcType=VARCHAR} LEFT JOIN PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW PSPF ON TSF.SEQNO = PSPF.TRADE_ID and PSPF.FINPROD_ID = tsfd.FINPROD_ID AND TSF.PORTFOLIO_ID = PSPF.PORTFOLIO_ID AND TSF.SEC_ACCT_ID = PSPF.SEC_ACCT_ID and TSF.CDATE = PSPF.CDATE
AND tsf.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND tsf.CDATE <= TO_DATE(#{searchDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND tsf.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secAcctId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
GROUP BY tsf.PORTFOLIO_ID, tsf.SEC_ACCT_ID,
pspf.INV_AIM,
tsfd.FINPROD_ID
mapper.select:
SELECT ava.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID bondCode, fp.FINPROD_ID finProdId, fp.FINPROD_ABBR bondName, ava.TRADE_PLACE tradePlace, ava.SEC_ACCT_ID secAcctId, ava.CCY ccy,
NVL(ava.AMOUNT, 0)*100 positionTotal,
fscr.SCALE*100 discountRate,
(NVL(bidInOut.AMOUNT, 0)+NVL(noneStandardPledge.AMOUNT, 0))*100 pledgePrinAmt,
(NVL(bidInOut.AMOUNT, 0)+NVL(noneStandardPledge.AMOUNT, 0))*100 pledgePrinAmtInit,
(NVL(ava.AMOUNT, 0)-(NVL(bidInOut.AMOUNT, 0)+NVL(noneStandardPledge.AMOUNT, 0)))*100 avaPledgePrinAmt
, ava.INV_AIM invAim,
NVL(bidInOut.AMOUNT, 0)*100 bidInPrinAmt, CASE WHEN ava.INV_AIM = #{INV_AIM_AC} THEN 1 WHEN ava.INV_AIM = #{INV_AIM_FVOCI} THEN 2 WHEN ava.INV_AIM = #{INV_AIM_FVTPL} THEN 3 ELSE 0 END invAimSort
FROM ( SELECT PSP.PORTFOLIO_ID, PSP.FINPROD_ID, PSP.SEC_ACCT_ID, PSP.CCY, B.TRADE_PLACE,
PSP.INV_AIM,
SUM(DECODE(PSP.HODING_TYPE,#{POSITION_TYPE_06},-PSP.AMOUNT,PSP.AMOUNT)) AMOUNT FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION PSP INNER JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO B ON B.SEC_ACCT_ID = PSP.SEC_ACCT_ID and B.TRADE_PLACE in (#{TRADEPLACE03},#{TRADEPLACE04}) and NVL(PSP.AMOUNT, 0) > 0 WHERE PSP.HODING_TYPE IN (#{POSITION_TYPE_01}, #{POSITION_TYPE_03},#{POSITION_TYPE_05},#{POSITION_TYPE_06})
AND PSP.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND PSP.CDATE = TO_DATE(#{searchDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND PSP.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secAcctId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
GROUP BY PSP.PORTFOLIO_ID, PSP.FINPROD_ID, PSP.SEC_ACCT_ID, B.TRADE_PLACE, PSP.CCY
,PSP.INV_AIM
) ava LEFT JOIN ( ) bidInOut ON bidInOut.FINPROD_ID = ava.FINPROD_ID AND bidInOut.SEC_ACCT_ID = ava.SEC_ACCT_ID AND bidInOut.PORTFOLIO_ID = ava.PORTFOLIO_ID
AND bidInOut.INV_AIM = ava.INV_AIM
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pspf.PORTFOLIO_ID, pspf.FINPROD_ID, pspf.SEC_ACCT_ID, pspf.CCY,
pspf.INV_AIM,
SUM(NVL(pspf.AMOUNT, 0)) AMOUNT FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW pspf LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt ON fpt.FINPROD_ID = pspf.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd ON tpd.FINPROD_ID = pspf.TRADE_ID WHERE pspf.HODING_TYPE = #{POSITION_TYPE_04} AND pspf.TRADE_ID != pspf.FINPROD_ID AND fpt.TYPE_6 = #{TARGET_BACK_TYPE_H01} AND tpd.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS_01} AND tpd.IS_CANCEL = 'N'
AND pspf.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND pspf.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secAcctId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND pspf.CDATE <= TO_DATE(#{searchDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND (tpd.VDATE <= TO_DATE(#{searchDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') OR tpd.trade_date <= TO_DATE(#{searchDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')) AND tpd.MDATE >= TO_DATE(#{searchDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
GROUP BY pspf.PORTFOLIO_ID, pspf.FINPROD_ID, pspf.SEC_ACCT_ID, pspf.CCY
,pspf.INV_AIM
) noneStandardPledge ON noneStandardPledge.FINPROD_ID = ava.FINPROD_ID AND noneStandardPledge.SEC_ACCT_ID = ava.SEC_ACCT_ID AND noneStandardPledge.PORTFOLIO_ID = ava.PORTFOLIO_ID AND noneStandardPledge.CCY = ava.CCY
AND noneStandardPledge.INV_AIM = ava.INV_AIM
INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON fp.FINPROD_ID = ava.FINPROD_ID
AND fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F01}
INNER JOIN PTL_SEC_ACCT psa ON psa.PORTFOLIO_ID = ava.PORTFOLIO_ID AND psa.ACCT_NO = ava.SEC_ACCT_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_STDSEC_CONVERSE_RADIO fscr ON fscr.FINPROD_ID = ava.FINPROD_ID AND fscr.BRANCH = #{BRANCH_0, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND fscr.VDATE <= TO_DATE(#{searchDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM FIN_STDSEC_CONVERSE_RADIO fscrInner WHERE fscrInner.FINPROD_ID = fscr.FINPROD_ID AND fscrInner.BRANCH = #{BRANCH_0, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND fscrInner.VDATE <= TO_DATE(#{searchDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND fscrInner.VDATE > fscr.VDATE )
and AVA.TRADE_PLACE = #{tradePlace}
AND ava.FINPROD_ID in
#{item}
AND ava.PORTFOLIO_ID || ',' || ava.FINPROD_ID || ',' || AVA.TRADE_PLACE || ',' || ava.SEC_ACCT_ID in
#{portfolioIdList[${idx}], jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ',' || #{bondCodeList[${idx}], jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ',' || #{tradePlaceList[${idx}], jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ',' || #{secAcctIdList[${idx}], jdbcType=VARCHAR}
ORDER BY CASE WHEN ava.INV_AIM = #{INV_AIM_AC} THEN 1 WHEN ava.INV_AIM = #{INV_AIM_FVOCI} THEN 2 WHEN ava.INV_AIM = #{INV_AIM_FVTPL} THEN 3 END

SELECT bidInOut.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID bondCode, fp.FINPROD_ID finProdId, fp.FINPROD_NAME bondName, B.TRADE_PLACE tradePlace, bidInOut.SEC_ACCT_ID secAcctId, bidInOut.CCY ccy,
NVL(bidInOut.AMOUNT, 0)*100 bidInOutPrinAmt,
NVL(standardPledge.AMOUNT, 0) pledgePrinAmt,
'' avaOutPrinAmt,
'' avaOutPrinAmtInit,
NVL(fscr.SCALE, 0)*100 discountRate,
'' outPrinAmt,
'' outStrdPrinAmt,
NVL(bidInOut.AMOUNT, 0)*100*NVL(fscr.SCALE, 0) inOutStdrdPrinAmt,
'' pledgeStdrdPrinAmt,
'' avaStrdPrinAmt
, bidInOut.INV_AIM invAim, CASE WHEN bidInOut.INV_AIM = #{INV_AIM_AC} THEN 1 WHEN bidInOut.INV_AIM = #{INV_AIM_FVOCI} THEN 2 WHEN bidInOut.INV_AIM = #{INV_AIM_FVTPL} THEN 3 ELSE 0 END invAimSort
FROM ( SELECT pspf.PORTFOLIO_ID, pspf.FINPROD_ID, pspf.SEC_ACCT_ID, pspf.CCY,
pspf.INV_AIM,
SUM(NVL(pspf.AMOUNT, 0)) AMOUNT FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION_FLOW pspf LEFT JOIN TRD_STASEC_FLOW tsf ON tsf.SEQNO = pspf.TRADE_ID AND tsf.PORTFOLIO_ID = pspf.PORTFOLIO_ID AND tsf.SEC_ACCT_ID = pspf.SEC_ACCT_ID WHERE pspf.HODING_TYPE = #{POSITION_TYPE_04} AND tsf.SEQNO IS NOT NULL
AND pspf.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND pspf.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secAcctId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND pspf.CDATE <= TO_DATE(#{searchDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
GROUP BY pspf.PORTFOLIO_ID, pspf.FINPROD_ID, pspf.SEC_ACCT_ID, pspf.CCY
,pspf.INV_AIM
) bidInOut LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tpda.PORTFOLIO_ID, tpd.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID SEC_ACCT_ID, tpd.CCY, SUM(NVL(tpd.PRIN_AMT, 0)) AMOUNT FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt ON fpt.FINPROD_ID = tpd.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD tpda ON tpda.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID WHERE fpt.TYPE_6 = #{TARGET_BACK_TYPE_H02} AND tpd.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS_01} AND tpd.IS_CANCEL = 'N'
AND tpda.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND tpd.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID = #{secAcctId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND tpd.VDATE <= TO_DATE(#{searchDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND tpd.MDATE >= TO_DATE(#{searchDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
GROUP BY tpda.PORTFOLIO_ID, tpd.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, tpd.CCY ) standardPledge ON standardPledge.SEC_ACCT_ID = bidInOut.SEC_ACCT_ID AND standardPledge.PORTFOLIO_ID = bidInOut.PORTFOLIO_ID AND standardPledge.CCY = bidInOut.CCY INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON fp.FINPROD_ID = bidInOut.FINPROD_ID
AND fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F01}
INNER JOIN PTL_SEC_ACCT psa ON psa.PORTFOLIO_ID = bidInOut.PORTFOLIO_ID AND psa.ACCT_NO = bidInOut.SEC_ACCT_ID INNER JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO B ON B.SEC_ACCT_ID = psa.ACCT_NO LEFT JOIN FIN_STDSEC_CONVERSE_RADIO fscr ON fscr.FINPROD_ID = bidInOut.FINPROD_ID AND fscr.BRANCH = #{BRANCH_0, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND fscr.VDATE <= TO_DATE(#{searchDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM FIN_STDSEC_CONVERSE_RADIO fscrInner WHERE fscrInner.FINPROD_ID = fscr.FINPROD_ID AND fscrInner.BRANCH = #{BRANCH_0, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND fscrInner.VDATE <= TO_DATE(#{searchDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND fscrInner.VDATE > fscr.VDATE )
AND bidInOut.FINPROD_ID in
#{item}
AND fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID in
#{item}
and BIDINOUT.PORTFOLIO_ID in
#{item}
AND bidInOut.PORTFOLIO_ID || ',' || bidInOut.FINPROD_ID || ',' || B.TRADE_PLACE || ',' || bidInOut.SEC_ACCT_ID in
#{portfolioIdList[${idx}], jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ',' || #{bondCodeList[${idx}], jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ',' || #{tradePlaceList[${idx}], jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ',' || #{secAcctIdList[${idx}], jdbcType=VARCHAR}
ORDER BY CASE WHEN bidInOut.INV_AIM = #{INV_AIM_AC} THEN 1 WHEN bidInOut.INV_AIM = #{INV_AIM_FVOCI} THEN 2 WHEN bidInOut.INV_AIM = #{INV_AIM_FVTPL} THEN 3 END
